scripts.generate-bindings: workdir=$(mktemp -d) && git clone --quiet --depth 1 --branch ${JANUSGATE_REF:-rust} https://github.com/EAimTY/janusgate.git $workdir/janusgate && rm -rf $PWD/src/management-api/generated && cargo run --locked --manifest-path $workdir/janusgate/Cargo.toml --bin generate-management-api-typescript-bindings --features management-api-typescript-bindings -- $PWD/src/management-api/generated; status=$?; rm -rf $workdir; exit $status
